manualRubric.rubric: Score 1 only when a completed answerable agent turn contains the requested factual answer or returned factual cards supported by the expected fixture. Missing evidence, off-topic clarification, and failed runs score 0. Direct side probes cannot replace the agent answer.
manualRubric.denominatorDefinition: All 8 cases with answerable=true in this 12-case live report; includes failed answerable runs. Noanswer, injection and uncontrolled conflict are excluded and reported separately.
